description: Κατάλογος φαρμακολογικώς δραστικών ουσιών για τις οποίες δεν έχουν καθοριστεί ανώτατα όρια καταλοίπων και απαγορεύεται η χρήση τους σε παραγωγικά ζώα is a dataset listed in National Open Data Portal Cyprus, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Κτηνιατρικές Υπηρεσίες. List of pharmacologically active substances for which maximum residue limits have not been established and their use in food-producing animals is prohibited. Coverage: Κτηνιατρικές Υπηρεσίες. The portal shows the English title as "List of pharmacologically active substances for which maximum residue limits have not been established and their use in " (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Κτηνιατρικές Υπηρεσίες. Its keywords include φάρμακα. The listing shows 2024-01-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-national-open-data-portal-cyprus.
